headline: Diesel, gas rollbacks seen next week
summary: Motorists in the Philippines can expect another round of oil price rollbacks next week, amid projections of weaker global fuel demand. Diesel could fall by P2.35 to P2.55 per liter and gasoline by P2 to P2.15.
why: Pump prices in the Philippines track global crude and refined product prices, which affects inflation, transport costs and household budgets.
